title: Lyon. Un ciel noir, des orages éclatent... la météo va radicalement changer en 48h
content: After a heatwave in August, Lyon has been hit by thunderstorms since Tuesday night. According to Météo-France, the weather is expected to change dramatically in the next 48 hours, with a return to 'normal' and seasonal temperatures by Friday and throughout the weekend. On Wednesday, the sky will remain overcast, with thunderstorms expected to subside before the evening and rain continuing until 8pm. Thursday will not see significant improvement in the weather. However, Météo-France predicts a return of the sun on Friday, with temperatures reaching up to 25°C and winds of up to 40 km/h. The weekend is expected to be sunny, with temperatures reaching up to 27°C on Sunday. However, rain may return as early as Monday and Tuesday.

title: Météo Lyon: prévisions du samedi 11 octobre 2025
content: On Saturday, October 11, 2025, Lyon is expected to have a beautiful and sunny day, with temperatures ranging from 13°C in the morning to 19°C in the afternoon. The average temperature for the day will be 15°C, with light cloud cover in the morning and a gentle northeast breeze. The afternoon will be particularly pleasant, with temperatures rising to between 16°C and 20°C. In the evening, after a brief period of cloudiness, the wind will gradually clear the sky. The transition from Saturday to Sunday will occur under clear skies. On Sunday, temperatures are expected to range between 10°C and 20°C, with clear skies in the morning, a light northeast wind, and a sunny afternoon. Evening skies will feature clearings, with temperatures around 14°C. A slight northwest breeze will be felt. Over the coming days, weather conditions are expected to remain stable, with an average temperature of 14°C and sunny conditions.

title: Météo : 2025, le troisième été le plus chaud de l'histoire en Tarn-et-Garonne après 2022 et 2003
content: The meteorological assessment of the 2025 summer in Tarn‑et‑Garonne, covering 1 June to 31 August, shows that it was the third hottest on record for the region.  The average maximum temperature reached 29.7 °C, with the peak daily maximum on 11 August recorded at 42 °C – the third highest ever measured in the commune.  In Montauban the same day the thermometer read 41.8 °C, while in Caylus it reached 40.7 °C.  The 2023 summer, which also featured a heatwave, had a comparable average maximum of 29.7 °C.  The two previous record summers were 2022 (32 °C) and 2003 (31.9 °C), as noted by the MétéoFrance technician: 'Seules les années 2022 avec 32°C et 2003 avec 31,9°C sont au-dessus depuis le début de nos relevés à Montauban, en 1963. Il y a malgré tout une énorme différence avec ces deux valeurs-là'.  Minimum temperatures followed a similar pattern, with 2025’s average low of 17.1 °C ranking just below 2003 (18.5 °C), 2022 (17.4 °C) and 2023 (17.2 °C).  July experienced a severe drought, with only 12 mm of rainfall recorded in Montauban compared to a 60‑year average of 47 mm, according to Valéry Moutot: 'Pour la station de Montauban, on a ainsi relevé 12 mm de précipitations seulement, contre une moyenne de 47 mm sur les 60 dernières années'.  June 2025 received 55 mm, slightly below the 68 mm average, while August saw 68 mm, surpassing the 55 mm average.  Moutot cautioned against generalising these figures across the department: 'Il est néanmoins très dangereux, sur cette donnée, d'extrapoler avec l'ensemble du département, altère le météorologiste'.  Overall, the 2025 summer was described as 'bien ensoleillé' and its insolation ranked 12th among the last 35 years.

title: Prévisions météo du lundi 18 août 2025 à Lyon
content: Lyon is expected to have a sunny day on Monday, August 18, 2025, with temperatures ranging from 24°C in the morning to 32°C in the afternoon. The heat wave is expected to continue, with temperatures reaching up to 33°C. Overnight, the sky will be clear. However, a temperature drop is expected for Tuesday, with temperatures ranging from 16 to 32°C. The heat wave is expected to continue, with temperatures reaching up to 32°C, but with a chance of scattered showers in the evening. A degradation in the weather is expected for the coming days, with temperatures in the mid-20s and a cloudy sky.

title: Prévisions météo du samedi 6 septembre 2025 à Lyon
content: The forecast for Lyon on Saturday 6 September 2025 predicts a sunny day with an average temperature of 19 °C and a light southeast breeze. In the afternoon temperatures will rise to 23–27 °C, evening temperatures will return to 19 °C, and the night will be clear. Tomorrow (Sunday) will also be sunny, with temperatures around 22 °C and a southeast wind of 19 km/h in the morning; afternoon temperatures will climb to 24–29 °C, followed by rain in the evening and a light southwest wind. The weather is expected to change gradually over the next few days, remaining stable on Monday before shifting again on Tuesday. 'Un bel ensoleillement est attendu aujourd'hui à Lyon.'

title: Août 2025, le troisième mois le plus chaud jamais enregistré en Dordogne - ici
content: In August 2025, the Dordogne department experienced its third‑hottest month on record since 1960, following August 2023 and August 2022, according to Météo France data. The average temperature was a little over 22 °C, a degree and a half above normal, as Thierry Godain, a forecaster at Météo France, noted 'ce qui est un degré et demi de plus par rapport à la normale'. A heatwave from 7 to 17 August averaged 35 °C and produced two record peaks. On 11 August every temperature record was broken: 43.5 °C in Monpazier, 42 °C in Périgueux, Bergerac, and the Eyzies, and nearly 42 °C in Montignac‑Lascaux. On 13 August temperatures never fell below 20 °C, with 23.6 °C in Bergerac, which Godain described as '23,6 degrés à Bergerac, ce qui se rapproche d’une nuit tropicale'. The month saw 260 hours of sunshine, 15 % more than normal, '15% de durée d’ensoleillement en plus que la normale'. The region remained very dry until 18 August, when thunderstorms on 19 and 20 August brought some rain. Heavy showers on 29 August raised August’s total rainfall to 63 mm, close to the usual 67 mm, with 30 mm recorded in Saint‑Martin‑de‑Fressengeas and Terrasson‑Lavilledieu and up to 50 mm in some spots.

title: Prévisions météo du vendredi 29 août 2025 à Lyon
content: The forecast for Lyon on Friday, 29 August 2025, predicts an average temperature of about 18 °C with a light south‑west breeze. The morning is expected to be bright and sunny, while the afternoon will see the appearance of clouds and scattered showers, with temperatures ranging between 17 °C and 21 °C and an overall average of 16 °C. Nighttime is expected to be clear between Friday and Saturday. Tomorrow, temperatures are projected to rise to a range of 13 °C to 24 °C, with a modest south‑west wind and a morning of light clouds delaying sunrise; the day will reach about 18 °C, and the afternoon will bring a beautiful sun with temperatures climbing to 23 °C–24 °C. The evening will remain relatively bright with some clear patches. Subsequent days will see gradual changes, with a slight improvement on Sunday but a general deterioration thereafter.

title: Quel temps est-il prévu à Niort et ses environs le lundi 25 août 2025 ?
content: On Monday 25 August 2025, Niort and its surroundings will enjoy a warm, largely cloudy day. Temperatures will start at 17 °C at dawn, climb to 29 °C around noon, rise further to 34 °C by mid‑afternoon, then fall to 31 °C by 18 h. Wind will vary between 20 km/h and 25 km/h in the morning, with gusts up to 60 km/h, and later strengthen to about 50 km/h before easing to 40 km/h. The sky will remain mostly cloudy, clearing slightly around 17 h and fully clearing by evening. Overnight, temperatures will drop to 15 °C by 6 h, with wind around 15 km/h. Tuesday will be clearer, with an average temperature of 23 °C and a maximum of 29 °C between 15 h and 16 h. The forecast explicitly states, 'Il n'y aura pas d'intempérie pendant la journée.'

title: Météo Lyon: prévisions du mercredi 8 octobre 2025
content: On Wednesday, October 8, 2025, Lyon will experience gradually clearing skies throughout the day, with morning temperatures around 14°C and afternoon highs reaching 19°C. The day's temperature range will be between 9°C and 19°C, with a northeast wind cooling the atmosphere. The afternoon will be sunny, promising pleasant conditions, as temperatures slightly increase to between 16°C and 19°C. Evening skies will clear after a brief period of clouds, with temperatures dropping to approximately 14°C. Overnight, from Wednesday to Thursday, the sky will remain cloudless. The following day, Thursday, October 9, 2025, will remain overcast in the morning, with persistent clouds and only limited sunshine in the afternoon. Light rain showers are expected, and temperatures will rise slightly to a minimum of 17°C and a maximum of 18°C. Evening conditions will remain gloomy, with temperatures around 15°C. Forecasters indicate that weather conditions will improve in the days after, with sunny skies and temperatures around 15°C.

title: Prévisions météo du mardi 26 août 2025 à Lyon
content: The weather forecast for Lyon on Tuesday, 26 August 2025 predicts a "splendid sun" with morning temperatures of 25 °C and afternoon highs of 27 °C, while overall daily highs range between 17 °C and 31 °C. A light southeast wind is expected, and the morning will be bright and sunny. In the afternoon clouds will gradually appear, bringing scattered showers that may require an umbrella; evening conditions will be unstable with small showers. The night will be clear and cloud‑free. For Wednesday, the average temperature will be 24 °C with a southeast wind that slightly cools the air. The morning will see a touch of sun, but clouds will develop in the afternoon and scattered showers are anticipated, with temperatures between 23 °C and 29 °C. Evening clouds will block the sun and rain is expected. The following days will see a gradual improvement after a brief period of bad weather on Thursday. The forecast emphasizes the need to prepare for changing conditions, especially the possibility of rain in the evening and night.
